name: First five

sprites.name: Bulbasaur
sprites.note: Fixed: the head has a second drawing (mouth open, at ticks 54 to 65, 126 to 137, 198 to 209 and 252 to 287), and its top right used to jump on those frames. It now faces the same way as the first. Every tick still matches the old file.

sprites.name: Jellicent
sprites.note: Matches the old file, except female with eyes closed: the old file showed the wrong eyes, this one shows her own shut eyes. The body is glossy see-through jelly, the ruff and frills softer. The open eyes glow faintly.

sprites.name: Arceus
sprites.note: All 1,008 frames match the old file, and every type's look at sample ticks. The gold is metal. The wheel's gems glow, the eyes faintly.

sprites.name: Christmas Corsoreef
sprites.note: Back redrawn at half its size, so it is the front's scale (75 × 74 beside 73 × 80), with its motion kept. Not matched yet: the back's garlands and ornaments are drawn bolder than the front's fine tinsel and small lights. Matching that means redrawing the tree by hand. Mark it Redo if you want that.

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Redone in Gen 5 style. Front: Insurgence keeps it with every pixel doubled; it is now its real size (77 × 84) and matches the Insurgence art pixel for pixel, normal and shiny. Back: Insurgence only has a bust cut off at the waist, so this back is new (85 × 88). The head, horn, flame and wing bones are that bust at the front's scale; the ribs, hips, legs, feet and tail below it are drawn new, in the front's design. Judge that lower half hardest. It moves on the front's beat: the head listens, the wings flex and spread, the flame licks.

note: Fourth look. Delta Charizard is back, redone in Gen 5 style, front and back. Archilles is in the library now. The other four are unchanged and keep your marks.
